dataset_name: FRED-MD archival next-month CPI and unemployment
target_name: US all-items consumer price index, seasonally adjusted
prompt:
Task: Estimate the US all-items consumer price index, seasonally adjusted for the month following the history.
Target: US all-items consumer price index, seasonally adjusted
Target unit: index (1982-1984 = 100)
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing.
Field definitions and context: The two arrays contain 24 consecutive US monthly observations, oldest to newest. CPIAUCSL is the seasonally adjusted all-items CPI (1982-1984=100). UNRATE is the seasonally adjusted civilian unemployment rate in percent. first_month dates the first observation. Data use the October 2026 vintage.
Input JSON: {"first_month":"1959-01","CPIAUCSL":[29.01,29,28.97,28.98,29.04,29.11,29.15,29.18,29.25,29.35,29.35,29.41,29.37,29.41,29.41,29.54,29.57,29.61,29.55,29.61,29.61,29.75,29.78,29.81],"UNRATE":[6,5.9,5.6,5.2,5.1,5,5.1,5.2,5.5,5.7,5.8,5.3,5.2,4.8,5.4,5.2,5.1,5.4,5.5,5.6,5.5,6.1,6.1,6.6]}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
